gaps: P0: none. P2: only #10 (small colored bird’s-eye, dated only 1690–1729). P5: none (#25 is the Palermo district of Buenos Aires).
notes: #17/#18 are Palermo park in Buenos Aires. #11 is the same Corografia plate as #13 (c. 1845), misattributed by LoC to 1765–80. #16 is from the Rijksmuseum’s 1778 ‘Voyage en Italie, en Sicile et à Malte’ album, probably by Louis Ducros; it shows the harbor more than the town, so drop it if a stricter second P3 is wanted. #22: the Aargau archive gives 1886, which may be the year the Gewerbemuseum acquired the print; Sommer could have made it some years earlier. #21 (Monte Pellegrino over the city from S. Maria di Gesù) is a stronger view but dated only ‘19th century’. P6 alternative: #26 (2008 panorama of center and port, but 6:1).
